verdict.rationale: Pylon agents can take action outside Pylon through Connectors, and admins can define a Custom API tool so agents call internal or third-party API endpoints. Support and Assist Agents are documented as able to perform actions, so the core mechanism of acting through your own APIs exists. Missing for 10: any documentation of scoped or per-action auth for those custom API tools, concrete examples of refunds, order changes or subscription updates, approval or guardrail controls on write actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
